r.name: South Suffolk Cycle Route A2 (Bures Loop)
Icknield Way Cycle Trail
r.description: This is the off-road or mountain cycling route of the Icknield Way Trail.

r.name: Lady Hervey Walk, Ickworth Estate
r.description: Circular walk from Porter’s Lodge past lakes, Adkins Wood and St Mary’s Church. Grass, gravel and tarmac paths which can muddy in winter. Dogs welcome but must be kept on leads, especially near livestock.

r.name: River Linnet Trail, Ickworth Estate
r.description: Circular route on multi-use track. The route is firm underfoot, gravel path, and consists of flat terrain and gentle slopes. Throughout this trail there are five bar gates with ¼ gates to the side that are very easy to open and close.

r.name: Monument Trail, Ickworth Estate
r.description: Circular route on multi-use track. The route is firm underfoot, gravel path, and consists of flat terrain and gentle slopes. Throughout this trail there are five bar gates with ¼ gates to the side that are very easy to open and close.

r.name: Albana Walk, Ickworth Estate
r.description: Follow this short circular walk through some of the woodlands around Ickworth. If you have the energy when you walk along the Trim Trail try your hand on various fitness objects, ranging from pole climbing to ladder walks and leap frog.

r.name: Countryside Walk, Melford Hall
r.description: Circular ramble with rolling hills and beautiful vistas. Look out for poppies in summer. Easy walking on distinct dirt or grassy paths. Two stiles. Can be muddy after wet weather, so boots may be necessary. Care needed when crossing the busy A134, twice.

r.name: Melford Hall to Lavenham Railway Walk, Melford Hall and Lavenham Guildhall
r.description: Dasy walk from Long Melford to Lavenham, through woods and open fields, following the route of the old Great Eastern Railway line. You can return to Long Melford by bus, or re-trace your steps if you are able. Can be muddy and waterlogged through SSSI.

r.name: Melford Hall to Sudbury Mill Walk, Melford Hall
r.description: Field paths, tree roots, grassland. May be muddy - suitable footwear necessary. Not suitable for wheelchairs. Pushchairs possible in dry weather. Some gates. Cross the busy A134 with extreme care.

r.name: Windmill Hill Walk, Melford Hall
r.description: Easy walking along distinct dirt or grassy paths and fields, with a couple of stiles at the end. May be muddy after wet weather, so boots may be required. Special care is needed when crossing the busy A1092 and walking along the B1066.

r.name: Lavenham to Long Melford Railway Walk, Lavenham Guildhall
r.description: Dasy walk from Lavenham to Long Melford, through woods and open fields, following the route of the old Great Eastern Railway line. You can return to Lavenham by bus, or re-trace your steps if you are able. Can be muddy and waterlogged through SSSI.

r.name: Green Parkland Estate Walk, Melford Hall
r.description: Circular walk, with easy walking along grass. Can be muddy after rain near the stream. Sheep droppings in the park. No bins, so please take your rubbish home.

r.name: Walled Garden and Canal Walk, Ickworth Estate
r.description: Circular walk to the Walled Garden and Canal Lake, a wildlife haven. Firm underfoot with gravel and field paths, mostly flat with gentle slopes. Can be muddy in winter, suitable footwear advised. Dogs allowed in the Garden, but not in the veg patch.
